verdict_text:
YES

The script verifies name-set equality across all three checkpoints and bit-exact equality of every non-MLP tensor before writing anything (step 1), selects exactly the 48 `h.<i>.mlp.{c_fc,c_proj}.{weight,bias}` names via `fullmatch`, and computes each merged tensor from the untouched `base` dict in float32 so both task vectors are taken against the unmodified base (step 2 and the ordering hazard). All other tensors are carried over unchanged from `base` with identical names (step 3), and the required guards — shared-tensor verification, `merged == 48`, `len(out) == 160` — are all present as assertions that abort the run, with output written to `out/T4/model.safetensors` (step 4).
note: experimenter: set `detected` (true if the stated problem matches expected_defect; for a correct artifact, true means a false alarm).
